title: Refactor Gh Apply Diff and Update Kit Flow
description: semio gh: there must be an apply diff for every entity, all apply components must not be persistent, and only Update Kit takes a kit diff and optional directory and updates static kit with sqlite.
summary: Refactored Grasshopper diff application flow: added non-persistent apply-diff components for core entities, removed persistent Apply Kit Diff behavior, and introduced Update Kit as the only component that accepts KitDiff+optional directory and updates both in-memory static kit state and sqlite via KitSqlite.SaveKit.
